prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Dallas for a dental implant?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" dentist for a dental implant, as the right specialist depends on whether you need a single tooth replacement, full-mouth restoration (like All-on-4), or bone grafting. However, Dallas features several top-rated, specialized implant centers and board-certified practitioners:
Lead Specialist: Dr. David McFadden (board-certified prosthodontist, practicing reconstructive dentistry in Dallas for over 25 years, and former director of the dental implant center at UT Southwestern Medical Center).
Focus: Dedicated specialist practice for tooth restoration and single-to-full-arch dental implants.
Location: Dallas, TX
Single Implant Post: $1,500 – $3,000
Crown / Abutment: $1,500 – $2,500
Total Average per Single Implant: $3,000 – $5,500 (excluding pre-requisite bone grafting or extractions if needed)
